questions.question: State and prove distributive laws of union and intersection of sets with examples.
questions.solution_html:
• [U) /
  • With any example matrix prove the Laws
  • Law 1: Union distributes over Intersection
  • A U (B ∩ C) = (A U B) ∩ (A U C)
  • Law 2: Intersection distributes over Union
  • A ∩ (B U C) = (A ∩ B) U (A ∩ C)
